dimensions.rationale: Nine requirements map to nine acceptance criteria, nine evidence routes and nine final gates, including exact declared comparison identity.
The four-workstream DAG is acyclic and all write paths are disjoint; WS27-04 owns exactly the two remediation files before WS27-02 revalidation.
The constructible mutation matrix covers same object, path alias, repeated comparison, repeated release, relabel-only and retained-lineage duplicates plus a distinct-release PASS control.
Duplicate identity fails before inflated sample count or measured reduction and does not change execution authority, quality floors or unavailable-data semantics.
The change remains a pure check in the existing metrics seam and does not add a second schema, store, workflow or execution subsystem.
Only exact-compatible accepted tasks may be preserved; changed WS27-02 is revalidated after WS27-04 and before publication finalization.
